n-7oxaigycyqpnb7mkj35qhg6hqa.body:
One small Python generator reads graph/nodes/*.yaml and writes a static site:
one page per node, a roadmap page, an /all index and a graph.json export. The
site is a pure function of the merged tree, so a fork renders the same pages
and CI can prove the build is reproducible.

n-np4zpgoq56i343bfuiuuh52mvi.body:
Every node file carries identity, provenance and append-only estimate
records. A reviewer reading a diff cannot confirm that an ID is well formed,
that a reference resolves, or that an estimate record was added rather than
quietly rewritten. Without a machine check the discipline is a convention,
and conventions decay under time pressure.
